children: Genome analysis solutions provider's Q3 revenue rose 12% yr/yr to $8.3 mln
Gross margin improved to 48% from 46% a year earlier
Operating expenses fell 12% to $10.5 mln in Q3
Bionano reiterates full-year 2026 revenue guidance of $31 mln to $33 mln
Company expects broader clinical adoption of OGM supported by reimbursement and regulatory progress
Bionano says momentum positions it for sustained growth in 2027 and beyond
OGM ADOPTION - Co said momentum in adoption of optical genome mapping (OGM) in clinical and commercial settings supported results
REIMBURSEMENT AND REGULATORY PROGRESS - Co cited coverage and regulatory progress for OGM-based testing as helping build a clearer reimbursement pathway
EVIDENCE BASE - Co noted new independent peer-reviewed studies demonstrating the value of OGM across a range of disorders
The current average analyst rating on the shares is "buy" and the breakdown of recommendations is 2 "strong buy" or "buy", no "hold" and no "sell" or "strong sell"
The average consensus recommendation for the advanced medical equipment & technology peer group is "buy"
Wall Street's median 12-month price target for Bionano Genomics, Inc. is $5.00, about 331% above its November 9 closing price of $1.16
